reviews.text: I have taken my chihuahua there for her anual and for an emergency. I was pleased with how they handled her even though she's like a t-rex with the exception she's only 6lbs. I like the fact that they understand that she's loud, wild and scared. I have no negative comments. The staff nice, the doctor she's nice aswell. Glad with their services.

We visited the clinic yesterday to get our 2  cats ready to travel.

This was one of the only places that actually knew exactly what we need to get our cats ready.

The lady at the front desk was very knowledgeable, very helpful, and very kind.

The vet itself is also very sweet lady that actually cares for your animals. She was also very knowledgeable and helpful and kind.

Very good experience compared to many places we went before. I would highly recommend this veterinarian if you need to get your pet ready to travel and for your everyday veterinarian needs.

I’m sure the doctor is incredible but this place has an extremely unthoughtful receptionist. If it’s 9:17 and the practice closes at 11, i’d expect someone to answer the phone after 3 calls. I arrived to the clinic just in case they accepted any walk ins since no one had answered, just for her to say they don’t take any cases anymore, which could’ve saved my pet and myself time in getting the care he needed had she mentioned this on the phone. people panic and worry when their pets are sick, don’t work with pets if you can’t sympathize with this. just horrible

Our 6-year-old shorkie was seen yesterday at Vet To Pet due to back-to-back vomiting. I was scared that she was dehydrated, so we took her at 9 p.m. to be seen. The front office assistant was incredibly nice and comforting. We waited about 20 minutes to be seen. The vet and his assistants were very kind and treated our baby so gently. The doctor examined her, discussed his observations, and gave us a plan of action. She was administered medication for the vomiting and sent on her way. I was expecting a huge bill but was happily surprised by a very reasonable price. So happy we took her to be seen. She is doing great!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I want to thank the entire team at Vet To Pet After Hours Animal Clinic for the excellent care they provided my American Bully. From the moment we arrived, I felt very reassured by their professionalism, the cleanliness of the clinic, and the loving care they gave my pet.

The veterinarians were very attentive, patiently explaining everything and finding the best option for my dog's well-being. I also want to highlight the receptionist, a very kind, sweet, and empathetic person; she took the time to explain everything so I could understand and make the best decisions for my pet.

I needed a harness (muzzle) for my dog, and they had all sizes available, which was a huge help.

Although my pet is still unwell and will continue with the treatment process, I have complete confidence in this team and will return to them to continue caring for his health.

I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic. You can tell when a team works with love and a true passion for animals. 🐾❤️
Dr. Yarelys and her team are the Best !!

I found a dog this evening I didn't know what to do. I look up for vet clinic but, was late I they were open. I asked for chip reader. They did right away and help me to find all information. Thank you
The best service for your pet and the best care, 100% recommended, quality and price

Excellent service from beginning to end. The staff was very friendly and attentive to my pet, and they explained everything clearly. They made me feel at ease throughout the entire process, and the service was quick and professional. I would definitely return and highly recommend them.

This is a clinic where I always treat me dogs , they are very friendly and compassionate, they answer all my questions and they are very professional! Totally recommend! My lil baby Oso is hospitalized here and I have peace of mind with them.
Very nice staff & vet. Extremely clean facility. Had to take my mischievous Yorkie.

Terrible place!
Cheaper prices don't justify advertising 24-hour emergency care and then turning us away when our dog showed symptoms of poisoning, even after we begged them to see him. No compassion at all. If you care about your pets, don't bring them here.

Pet owners should be aware.

Horrible place!
Cheaper prices don't justify advertising 24-hour emergency care and then turning us away when our dog showed symptoms of poisoning, even after we pleaded with them to see him. They have no compassion whatsoever.
If you care about your pets, don't bring them here.

Our puppy Luna had not been eating and was vomiting for several days. Another clinic told us it was gastritis, but she kept getting worse. On a Sunday, we brought her here, and the amazing team quickly discovered that something was blocking her intestines. They performed surgery that same day, removed the obstruction, and she improved immediately. The vets stayed in constant communication throughout her stay, sending us photos and videos. Truly amazing care, we would absolutely recommend them and will return if needed.
Excellent service from everyone at the animal clinic, starting with the front desk... 100% recommended
Amazing staff and doctors. The love and care show to our animals is nothing short of top notch. Thanks again.

Me and my brother found a 4 month old cat and took it to this clinic for help; they are the most loving and kind group of Drs/staff around. They kindly offer answers to every question and treat the pets with such love and care. The Dr always remembers my cat's name!! Truly thankful to them and their care for others.

The prices are more affordable than at other veterinary clinics, making it possible to pay for pet treatment. Knowing how tough the economy is right now and how expensive everything is, it's a blessing to find more affordable and accessible options for everyone.
The best veterinarian staff

We’ve been bringing Cody here since he was a puppy, and we couldn’t be more grateful for the care and dedication this clinic provides. The staff truly knows him and has always made us feel comfortable and supported, no matter the situation. Vet to Pet After Hours Clinic is not only professional, but also very compassionate, which makes all the difference. It’s a place we completely trust for Cody’s health. Highly recommended!

They charge you before the treatment and tell you they'll call you before 11 am to pick up your pet because they're very busy. When we arrived, there were only two animals, and after an hour, it was full. They told us they'd call us to pick up our pet just to treat an infection in its tail from a bite—more than three hours for this, incredibly illogical. And charging you before the treatment... I think all they care about is the money.

I came in with a white kitten that we found in our neighborhood and that had trouble breathing. She was previously diagnosed with pneumonia in a different vet clinic and was sent home but could barely breathe a couple of hours later. We took her to this clinic when she was on the verge of dying and they helped us so much. The vet kindly offered to keep her on oxygen until the clinic closed so we had time to locate an overnight vet because they closed at 11pm and didn’t offer the intensive overnight care that the kitten needed at the time. We had her on oxygen for about 4 hours AT NO COST to which we then transferred her to the Doral Animal Center. We were not pressured into any payments and were helped tremendously by them. They definitely value their kindness and the pet’s life more than just being a greedy vet business. If we would’ve gone to any other place, they would’ve charged us hundreds and we simply wouldn’t have been able to afford it at the time. Because of them and the Doral Animal Center, the kitten survived and is now about to be 12 weeks old! We are extremely grateful for this clinic and hope others see their commitment and value to the health of pets.
Great place and service
The best doctors, they saved my baby, today he walks thanks to them, highly recommended
Great place, friendly staff and the doctor was very patient and explained everything really well. I felt real good bringing my dog in for an emergency.
Very professional
Best vet office, been going there for a few yrs now. Im so happy I have an option to go after work and have the best care for my fur babies.
Excellent

Listen to the other 1 stars like I wish I had. I would strongly advise against bringing your pet to this location, especially if Dr. Martinez is involved. His smug and condescending attitude is incredibly off-putting, as he seems to believe he's intellectually superior to everyone in the room. While he may be "educated" in his field, he certainly lacks the basic empathy and understanding required to deal with pet owners going through difficult situations. Not everyone’s circumstances are the same, and it would do him some good to come down from his high horse and recognize that fact.

Instead of offering support, Dr. Martinez seems more interested in showcasing his arrogance and dismissing any concerns you may have. A little humility could go a long way for someone who’s supposed to be in a caregiving profession. Until he learns to treat clients with respect and understanding, I cannot recommend this place. Save yourself the frustration and look elsewhere for compassionate care.
Excellent
They give you an estimate, then come back with another, much higher one. If you don't accept it, you still owe $65.00 because the vet already saw the pet.

Thank you to Dr. Martinez for her love and commitment to our dogs. I have a French Bulldog, and she's the only one who has truly cared for my dog ​​after going to so many different places. Thank God I found her here. The doctor and her team have helped me so much with my dog. Thank you, Dr. Martinez and your team! We are so grateful for your dedication, love, and commitment. This is an excellent place, highly recommended. This will always be Luna's doctor.

I can't thank Vet to Pet enough for the incredible care they provided for my cat. After having surgery at another office, my cat’s wound got badly infected. The team at Vet to Pet was so compassionate and knowledgeable. They immediately assessed the situation, opened her up again, treated the infection, and managed the recovery process with such skill. The vet was not only professional but she also took the time to explain everything clearly, and I felt so reassured throughout the whole experience.THANK YOU DR.YARELIS MARTINEZ
Excellent service and very good prices on everything. Thank you very much. I recommend it.

What a great team this place has! Everyone is so kind, and professional. The price is so reasonable. I went in a panic because my cat wasn't well. I went back to pick up my cat feeling so secure that he was going to be okay, and with medicine in hand and laughed with the staff. They let me know that at any moment if I have any concerns I can give them a call or come back. I felt so safe with this team. I will be coming back!

I can’t thank Vet to Pet After Hours Animal Clinic enough for the exceptional care they provided for my pet during a very stressful time. The staff was compassionate, knowledgeable, and efficient, ensuring my furry friend received immediate attention. The vet took the time to explain the situation clearly and answered all my questions, putting me at ease. The facility was clean, well-equipped, and clearly focused on the well-being of animals. I highly recommend this hospital to anyone in need of emergency care for their pets. Truly outstanding service!
They have good doctors, good prices, and have always taken good care of my animals.
Amazing service, always professional and caring, my 16 year old dog is alive and well thanks to their constant care. I would never go anywhere else!
This is the best place ever I only trust dr Martinez I come all the way from westpalm to see her .

Extremely disappointed and frustrated with the service  . We arrived at 3:40 pm, just 1 hour and 20 minutes before closing time, with my dog bleeding profusely after being attacked by a cat. You would think they would make an exception, but nope! They refused to provide even a glass of water to help us, citing that they were closing soon.

As a pet owner, it's shocking to see such a lack of compassion and care. My dog was suffering, and they didn't even offer basic first aid or guidance. The staff seemed more concerned with wrapping up their day than helping an animal in distress.

Needless to say, we will never be back, and I would advise others to think twice before taking their pets to this clinic

I am Francisco Cabrera's wife, and today, June 30, 2024, you took care of my Princess Cabrera. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic in Hialeah. I was lucky enough to find you today and took my princess there. They treated me like they'd known me forever. Dr. Yarelis Martínez and all the staff were incredibly professional and attentive to my dog ​​and to us. I've visited several clinics, and honestly, their prices are exorbitant. At this clinic, they performed all kinds of tests, X-rays, and examined her thoroughly. They gave her several intravenous and oral treatments, and also provided seven medications for me to take home. What they charged me at another clinic would have cost me three times that amount. I recommend them 100%. You will be extremely satisfied. I wouldn't change clinics for anything. Thank you guys for saving my princess 😘 I also want to add that before going I called to make sure they were open and a girl named Ester answered and she was super friendly and offered me a lot of information over the phone and everything she explained was exactly how it happened when they treated my dog.

Dr. Martínez is the best vet I’ve had. She started seeing my pup in 2012 when my dog was 4 years old and back then Dr Martinez did mobile house calls. After that I followed Dr Martinez around to her different clinic locations all around …
